scope: Read-only independent audit of five requested event/entity distinctions; no broad collection or target mutation.

checks.finding: Official newsroom dates July 30; company-issued wire announces July 31. Both describe the same USD63m extension with General Atlantic leading; wire explicitly includes Across. Month precision is defensible.
checks.action: Preserve conflict and month precision. Do not add cumulative USD313m as a further transaction.

checks.finding: Company distinguishes Conductor origin in 1999, Antonio joining as CEO in 2012, Dock internal venture in 2018, and group rebrand in 2021. EY explicitly labels Antonio founder/CEO while also describing his 2012 arrival.
checks.action: Keep founder_scope and milestones; do not attribute predecessor founding to Antonio.

checks.finding: Event dateline and embargo are February 24, 2021; blog publication is March 26. Later company debt announcement explicitly states the earlier Series C was US$70m.
checks.action: Keep February 24 announcement, USD70m amount; exclude BRL40m debt and converted BRL headline from venture total.

checks.finding: Contract page 4 explicitly identifies Nomad Tecnologia e Participações Ltda as constituted under Brazilian law, with São Paulo seat and the recorded CNPJ. Company footer separately locates Nomad Fintech Inc. in Orlando.
checks.action: Keep scoped entities; leave US incorporation and single global HQ unknown.

checks.finding: Company expressly names retained participants. Fidelity is a new key shareholder, not explicitly a lead. Advent participation is expressed through affiliate Sunley House Capital. The omitted Lightock spelling remains disclosed as an identity-resolution gap.
checks.action: Retain participant roles and partial-roster caveat. No lead upgrade or parent/affiliate double count.

nonblocking_cautions.finding: Undated website role labels were observed on retrieval date; effective appointment date is not established.
nonblocking_cautions.recommendation: Describe 2026-11-18 as observation date, not an official appointment/effective date.

nonblocking_cautions.finding: Flattening could remove the already recorded distinction between modern Dock founder and 1999 predecessor.
nonblocking_cautions.recommendation: Preserve scoped founder provenance and history as profile facts; omit an unqualified scalar founding year.
